_doc: Macro hypotheses as DSL terms (agent/terms.py: types, variables, expression syntax), read by runmodel.BasePolicy (price rollouts, scripted screen) and tools/baseline.py (Macro, PriceMacro). Units: P(win)-points (rollout worth / 2). Set a value to 0 or a when to False to ablate; MACRO_RULES=off drops all terms.

density.skill: user: density is deck size relative to draw (a big deck that draws through itself is fine); 4 turns = the old 20-card target with no draw cards; sts2-deckbuilding 2.7; E64/E67

skip_margin.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 2.7a: past ~20 cards skip ties (< 2 se); E66: 15 of 20 operator card rewards skipped; at every size it starved act 1 (A/B 2026-10-10: 5 of 8 died by the act-1 boss)

removal_first.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 2.7c: removals before marginal cards; E66: removal +0.18 at the act-3 shop

keep_gold_for_removal.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 6: keep gold for later; E64: 45-415 gold unspent at act-3 deaths while decks bloated

bundle_bonus.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 2.1/2.3 + user: a core piece of a live plan (agent/synergy.py core_owned) taken at a small negative; bet value priced by rollouts that prefer it

anti_veto.skill: user: a free relic or card can shut off a plan (Tungsten Rod vs Inferno/Rupture 1-HP triggers); data/synergy_candidates.json anti pairs with decomp cites

stranding_cost.skill: user: ignored cards signal the bottleneck; control arm: costly cards stranded per turn vs death floor r -0.61 (act 1) / -0.55 (act 3)

stranding_energy.when: bn_turns >= 10 and stranded >= 0.3 and 'energy_gain' in provides
stranding_energy.skill: user: stranded costly cards -> energy relics / cards; same evidence as stranding_cost

max_hp_value.skill: max HP is a whole-run resource the staged price horizon (next-act readiness) barely sees: BASE0015 Tablet of Truth kept deciphering, -21 max HP for 3 random upgrades (Keep Deciphering -12 priced +0.011 ready; search check -0.031); test: A/B + the event's search check

gap_fill.skill: user: judge cards as a whole, category gaps count; sts2-deckbuilding 3 (section-3 bar: open buckets take on numbers)

consistency.when: scaling_owned >= 1 and is_card and ('draw' in provides or 'energy_gain' in provides)
consistency.skill: user: scaling solved by the engine (Demon Form) -> value putting it in play on time; E72: Battle Trance + Cure All put Demon Form+ in play T2 vs the Queen

deadline.skill: user: a later floor knows more, an early draft carries more regret: take a card now only if a fight before the next offer needs it; plan stage A skip/deadline (rollouts: structural rule, predictor values)
